240-2034-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1556-2026-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
1556-2026-2645-3430.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2557-4365-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2034-5003-7645.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Swarmweaver, adding {C}{C}.
When The Swarmweaver dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return The Swarmweaver from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When The Swarmweaver enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2744-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-3738-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2511-3738-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1479-2841-4288-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-4288-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5078-6918-7052.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2919-3490-4659-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4659-4716.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

6568-6995-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
6568-6995-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Lulu by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

380-851-2726-2972.description:
Cast Miirym either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{G}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Miirym spell, creating two token copies of Miirym.
Put all but one legendary Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Miirym spell. Choose to put the nontoken Miirym into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Miirym you control and Ganax trigger,
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve a Miirym trigger, creating two token copies of Miirym that aren't legendary.
When the Miirym tokens enter, Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 8 for each remaining trigger, if applicable.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 11 until you control no Treasures and/or you have enough mana to cast Miirym from the command zone.
Repeat from step 1.
380-851-2726-2972.notes: The starting cost assume you haven't cost Miirym from the command zone this game. You can perform the combo if you've cast Miirym this game from the command zone, but will need additional mana to do so.

2099-2866-4211-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

5231-6054-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

3525-3586-5115.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2} and causing you to copy the next ability you activate or spell you cast that has {X} in its cost.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
Once you have a large number of delayed triggers, cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its cost to have Magus Lucea Kane copy that spell or ability infinitely.

1563-2457-3129-3480.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

122-328-2732-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

2523-5147-5559.description:
Cast Nazgûl by paying {2}{B}.
Nazgûl enters, triggering its first activated ability, causing the Ring to tempt you; choose Nazgûl as your Ring-bearer, making it legendary.
Nazgûl's second activated ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nazgûl.
Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Nazgûl that's a 2/2 Zombie.
Resolve the ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

11-799-5257.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Karn's Temporal Sundering, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and returning the original Karn's Temporal Sundering to your hand.
Resolve Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-799-5257.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

3487-4415-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Stonecloaker
3487-4415-5674.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters the battlefield, it and Aetherstorm Roc trigger.
Resolve the Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Stonecloaker trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4311-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat

1819-4797-5510-5514.notablePrerequisites:
You have a number of copies of Persistent Petitioners in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
Tormod's Cryptkeeper does not have summoning sickness.
1819-4797-5510-5514.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Persistent Petitioners from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Persistent Petitioners in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Persistent Petitioners as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Tormod's Cryptkeeper by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Tormod's Cryptkeeper dies, Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Tormod's Cryptkeeper ability, exiling your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

369-539-1052-1315.notablePrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-539-1052-1315.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability from step 1, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

824-2464-3921.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
824-2464-3921.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from target creature and putting two +1/+1 counters on a different creature due to Winding Constrictor.
Repeat.

1213-1824-3152-4152.notablePrerequisites:
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation.
At least one creature died this turn.
1213-1824-3152-4152.description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Treasure Token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Acererak the Archlich by paying {B}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Acererak the Archlich enters the battlefield and triggers, returning Acererak the Archlich to your hand and venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time your trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1292-3117-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2034-2820-3175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Angelic Renewal triggers, causing you to sacrifice Angelic Renewal and return Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
